correctness.rationale: All 2^16 subsets of each explicitly defined graph are exhaustively classified; the face count vectors are (1,16,88,208,228,132,56,16,2) and (1,16,88,208,228,128,56,16,2), respectively. The complete pivot-rule Morse matching is verified from 371 and 367 explicit pairs, leaving one 0-face and three or seven 3-faces. Its explicit topological-order certificates verify all 2836 and 2816 directed Hasse incidences, giving a genuine acyclic matching. Forman CW reduction proves the asserted integral wedge homotopy types; independent mod-2 ranks corroborate them without standing in for integral proof. Exact integer Faddeev-LeVerrier recurrence computes identical adjacency characteristic polynomials λ^6(λ²-4)^4(λ²-16). The packaged verifier and all required certificate paths were executed successfully.

originality.rationale: The Hoffman graph cospectral with Q4 is treated spectrally by van Dam (2008, section 3), not topologically. Bousquet-Mélou–Linusson–Nevo (2007) prove Morse results for open/cylindrical grid independence complexes, not Hoffman. The full published-finding corpus four-cube proof treats only Q4 and expressly makes no Hoffman assertion; the preexisting cube theorem and the exact rational Q4 symmetry representation were excluded. Searches of published-finding corpus, relevant primary literature, and graph-tabulation sources yielded no covering Hoffman independence-complex homotopy result. The nonexistence of unindexed coverage cannot be proven, and there is no claim of independent novelty certification.
residual_risks: Indexed source discovery and the published-finding corpus similarity search cannot prove universal novelty; an unindexed prior Hoffman-graph homotopy computation could exist.
Interactive portions of House of Graphs were not accessible, so no claim is made that every database invariant was checked.
The historical 1963 Hoffman original is known by bibliographic description but not inspected in full; no daily publication date was imputed.
The work has not received independent external audit.

value.rationale: The Hoffman graph is the canonical 16-vertex four-regular cospectral mate of the four-cube. The natural question whether their independence-complex homotopy types agree tests a real boundary of graph spectral determination. The complete integral homotopy types differ by four sphere generators, while the independence polynomials differ only at five-vertex independent sets. The Hoffman result is a standalone exact topological classification of a natural exceptional graph, finer than graph spectra, basic independent-set counts, or a recomputation of a known table; it has interpretable mathematical significance independent of any family-wide theorem.
